ticker_news.title: Prediction: Nvidia Stock Is Going to Drop After Feb. 26
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the massive investments by tech giants like Microsoft, Amazon, and Meta into AI infrastructure, which should benefit Nvidia in the short term. However, the author expresses concerns that these investments may not pay off, leading to a collapse in demand for Nvidia's AI accelerators and a potential peak in the company's stock price.
ticker_news.author: Timothy Green

ticker_news.title: 25 Top AI Stocks That Could Boost Your Portfolio
ticker_news.description: The article discusses the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) on the global economy and highlights 25 top AI companies across various industries, from chip makers to cloud providers. It suggests that despite the recent appreciation of AI-related stocks, the AI investment landscape remains rich with opportunity.
ticker_news.author: George Budwell
